command: Schizosaccharomyces pombe Trm4b (O13935; gene directory trm402) methylates rRNA or mRNA at cytosine C5, participates in rRNA processing or mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit assembly. Evaluate each independently from established tRNA C49/C50 methylation. PMID:30646830 identifies tRNA-site specificity and leaves other RNA substrates open; a negative tRNA C34 result is not a negative rRNA/mRNA assay. Examine PTN000516076 placement and experimentally supported descendants, including verifying identity of MGI:1919431 rather than assuming it is NSUN4, plus the separate ISS provenance for mRNA activity. Distinguish positive evidence for a different substrate from demonstrated loss of these functions.
